column4: the Colour map box picks Ember, Blue-yellow safe and Classic; the newest line is read back as its strongest colour (classic 779188, Ember DD7A00) and the key follows (WaterfallLook.custom)
1 line/s gives 9 to 13 lines in ten seconds (read back: lines made, line spacing, the footer); a line every 10 s; back to every frame
the box picks UTC and local clock stamps (read back: the second tick reads HH:MM:SS) and back to age
Min hold is picked from the Trace box; the held columns are counted and are gone in Normal
Trace shape Filled and Bars are picked and read back (the pictures are the screenshots; the pixels are test_slint_host_trace_modes)
3 strongest finds the generator carrier (count and frequency read back); Off takes the labels away
Band zoom frames the tuned frequency 200 kHz wide (the span read back) and Full span puts the baseband back
the SNR box reads the generator carrier against the median floor
the channel power is read back
the tracker finds the carrier (valid, frequency)
the history graph fills (samples read back) and the CSV is saved and read back (rows)
Save the trace as the reference (the covered columns are read back), Show reference off and on, Clear
Compact window forces the compact strip at 1920 wide and back (the window flag is read back)
the right-click menu cannot be opened by the scripted input: `radio menuhz` / `radio menu` call the same handler; A and B are set and the delta read back (10 kHz), then cleared
a bookmark added, the receiver tuned 100 kHz away, the click on the name tunes back

the pinch handler of the host: `radio pinch` calls it (zoom in and out read back); the Slint gesture event itself cannot be made by the scripted input and there is no touch screen: UNVERIFIED on real touch
WATERFALL adds lines (read back)
AUTOCORR finds the tone (peak 95 to 105 Hz for the 100 Hz tone)
CEPSTRUM reads a pitch of 90 to 110 Hz for the tone
EYE folds the baseband I (traces read back); a second press goes back to the tube
